facts.fact: A Council of Ministers decree that came into force in April 2026 created the National Commission for Artificial Intelligence (CNIA), subordinate to the Council of Ministers, to advise the Government on ethical, legal, security and social issues of AI, as reported by Lusa via Club of Mozambique.

MOZ.note: The CNIA is an advisory body; no government use of an AI system is stated.
No sectoral AI tool is stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing is stated.
